title: Fourier coefficient bounded by the first norm
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f\colon\{\pm1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be any function. For every subset $S$ of the coordinates, the absolute value of the Fourier coefficient of $f$ on $S$ is at most its uniform $L^1$ norm.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
$S$ is a finite set of coordinates
